notes: Sony's FY2024 20-F (year ended March 31, 2025) splits employees only into Japan (57,500) and outside Japan (54,800), with no country detail. Item 4.D lists major facilities with carrying amounts and employee counts, and the sites come from that table. The last number in each site quote is the employee count; subsidiary counts are rounded to the nearest hundred and, for entities marked *5, include their subsidiaries. Sony Corporation of America's row in the table spans three segment lines (1,300, 6,700 and 1,500 employees), and only the first line is quoted. Sony Pictures' 'primary location' is given as Delaware in the filing, although its studio operations are not described there. No state-level or tax-by-country data was found in the 20-F.
